content: LLM usage dashboards and quota trackers universally show: (1) percent remaining as the primary metric (CodexBar fill represents percent remaining by default; minimax-usage-checker shows remaining prompts/%; GitHub Actions shows minutes remaining), (2) reset timing — CodexBar offers both relative countdown 'Resets in' and absolute 'Reset at' layout tokens and calls reset countdowns its core value ('Plan around resets'), (3) per-window usage (session/weekly/monthly windows each with own countdown), (4) refresh with stale-data resilience (TokenBar: 'A failed refresh never blanks a reading — the last known value stays until a fresh one lands'). GitHub Actions billing: minutes reset to full at start of each billing cycle; usage blocked at 100% without payment method; email alerts at 90%/100%.
